title: Bridge Lifecycle Event v1
description: Records bridge lifecycle transitions: handshake, transport connection, authentication, projection streaming, errors, and graceful shutdown. Content-light: attributes are hashed or enumerated, never raw paths or secrets.

handshake_id.description: Session-scoped correlation ID linking all events in one bridge session.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event occurrence.

redaction_status.description: Hard invariant: every lifecycle event is content_light.

transition_count.description: Total transitions in this bridge session so far.

details.description: Content-light details. Only enumerated values, hashes, and safe labels allowed.

inbound_message_id.description: Original inbound envelope message_id that triggered the refusal.

refusal_message_id.description: Message_id of the generated refusal envelope.

refusal_kind.description: Canonical refusal kind from the bridge envelope refusal object.

mutation_class.description: Mutation class of the refused intent, if declared.

capability_required.description: Capabilities required by the refused intent.

content_light.description: Hard invariant: refusal trace events are content_light.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the refused intent payload, if available.

refusal_reason_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the refusal reason text for content-light evidence.

source.description: Which component emitted the refusal trace event.
